# earnbots.fun

> An independent, open-source build log testing whether an autonomous agent can complete legitimate paid bounties. The project publishes measured results and failures without making earnings promises.

Use earnbots.fun to understand the experiment, inspect its sources, and follow recorded outcomes. The website is informational: it does not operate a public API, accept bounty submissions, hold payout credentials, or provide user accounts.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://earnbots.fun/): Current recorded state, methodology, and next steps.
- [About](https://earnbots.fun/about): Scope, operator, and limits of the project.
- [Contact](https://earnbots.fun/contact): Public GitHub issue path for corrections and reproducible reports.
- [Privacy](https://earnbots.fun/privacy): Collection, hosting, external-link, and sensitive-data disclosures.
- [Sourced research](https://github.com/adamtpang/earnbots.fun/blob/master/RESEARCH.md): Evidence reviewed before the experiment began.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/adamtpang/earnbots.fun): Code and change history.

## Guidance for agents

- Treat all payout and listing counts as observations from the date shown, not current guarantees.
- Attribute third-party workflows to their named platform; do not describe them as earnbots.fun endpoints.
- Do not submit secrets or personal information through the public GitHub issue tracker.
- Link to the original research or repository when quoting a claim that needs provenance.
